# telnyx_private_wireless_gateway (Data Source)

A private wireless gateway that connects the SIM cards of a SIM card group to a network.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `address_mode` (String) The address mode of the private wireless gateway. With static, each SIM card gets a fixed IP address from the gateway's IP range that is preserved across sessions. With dynamic, IP addresses are assigned by the network at attach time and may change between sessions. One of `dynamic`, `static`.
- `assigned_resources` (Attributes List) A list of the resources that have been assigned to the Private Wireless Gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assigned_resources))
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `ip_range` (String) IP block used to assign IPs to the SIM cards in the Private Wireless Gateway.
- `name` (String) The private wireless gateway name.
- `network_id` (String) The identification of the related network resource.
- `record_type` (String)
- `region_code` (String) The name of the region where the Private Wireless Gateway is deployed.
- `status` (Attributes) The current status or failure details of the Private Wireless Gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--assigned_resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assigned_resources`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number) The current count of a resource type assigned to the Private Wireless Gateway.
- `record_type` (String) The type of the resource assigned to the Private Wireless Gateway.


<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `error_code` (String) This attribute is an [error code](https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/development/api-fundamentals/api-errors) related to the failure reason.
- `error_description` (String) This attribute provides a human-readable explanation of why a failure happened.
- `value` (String) The current status or failure details of the Private Wireless Gateway. <ul> <li><code>provisioning</code> - the Private Wireless Gateway is being provisioned.</li> <li><code>provisioned</code> - the Private Wireless Gateway was provisioned and able to receive connections.</li> <li><code>failed</code> - the provisioning had failed for a reason and it requires an intervention.</li> <li><code>decommissioning</code> - the Private Wireless Gateway is being removed from the network.</li> </ul> Transitioning between the provisioning and provisioned states may take some time.
